'''Shaneeka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she was the chief engineer of the hidden township of [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. As many of her predecessors in this job had died prematurely during attacks on the village, she was always very busy repairing and maintaining the town's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].

The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Quharek]] helped her maintain most of the electronics and machinery in Aurilia.

==Behind the scenes==
Shaneeka was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. She could be found next to the town's shield generator, and was not involved any of the game's quests.

Shaneeka was added to the game with [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]] in November [[2007]], along with the rest of the new township of Aurilia.
